cases.question: How many expenses did I submit in each month of 2026? Show the month number (1-12) and the count.
cases.sql:
SELECT 
    m.month_number,
    COUNT(e.expense_id) AS count
FROM
    (SELECT 1 AS month_number FROM dual
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 2 FROM dual
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 3 FROM dual
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 4 FROM dual
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 5 FROM dual
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 6 FROM dual
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 7 FROM dual
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 8 FROM dual
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 9 FROM dual
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 10 FROM dual
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 11 FROM dual
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 12 FROM dual) m
LEFT JOIN hr.expenses e
ON e.submitted_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
AND e.submitted_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.submitted_at) = m.month_number
AND e.employee_email = 'rkhanna'
GROUP BY m.month_number
ORDER BY m.month_number
cases.answer: In 2026, you submitted expenses as follows: 1 in January, 1 in February, 2 in March, 1 in April, 1 in May, 2 in June, 1 in July, 1 in August, 0 in September, 3 in October, 0 in November, and 0 in December.
